name: replace-keeps-supplied-ttl-no-restamp
$comment: Pins the ttl-design ruling that replace never stamps the ttl default ("no special handling ... defaultDurationMs is never re-stamped after insert"): the seed insert stamps expiresAt at wall-clock now+1h, the replace then supplies an explicit tiny literal, and the follow-up read returns exactly that literal — the stored expiry is the caller's, with no stamp assistance on the replace path. (The spec's sibling scenario — a replace that OMITS expiresAt leaving the row non-expiring, 'Mongo semantics' — is unreachable under shipped validation: validate_ttl admits only a bare number/int64 field, which is required, so a replace omitting it is a SCHEMA_VIOLATION on every runner. Companion to upsert-insert-stamps-ttl-default, which pins the insert-branch stamp.)
